_comment: Theme template — copy this file, rename it, and fill in the values. Required fields: name, author, description, version, colors, fonts, preview. All other sections are optional — omit them entirely for Tier 1 (palette) themes.
name: My Theme
author: Your Name
description: One sentence describing the aesthetic and the feeling it targets.
_comment_tier: tier: 'palette' (colors+fonts only), 'atmospheric' (background/overlay/panel), 'immersive' (adds canvas animation). Must match what fields are actually used.
_comment_colors: All color values must be valid hex (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) or rgba(). Alpha channel in hex is the last two digits.
_comment_fonts: main: UI chrome, labels, buttons. code: chat messages, code blocks. Use CSS font-family stack syntax.
_comment_preview: Three colors shown in the theme picker card. Background, dominant text, accent.
_comment_background: Tier 2+. Set type to 'image' and provide a src path to enable. src is relative to webui root (e.g. '/themes/assets/my-background.jpg'). opacity: 0.0–1.0. blur: pixels >= 0. Omit this entire block for Tier 1 themes.
_comment_panel: Tier 2+. opacity < 1.0 makes panels translucent so the background bleeds through. backdrop_blur adds frosted glass blur. Both require a background to look intentional.
_comment_overlay: Tier 2+. CSS effects layered above everything. All are optional — set enabled: false to disable. Scanlines: CRT line structure. Vignette: darkened screen edges. Noise: film grain via SVG feTurbulence. Watermark: SVG emblem centered on screen.

vignette._comment: opacity: 0.15–0.4. Heavy vignette anchors the eye to center.

watermark._comment: src: path to SVG in themes/assets/. opacity: 0.03–0.08. position: CSS background-position value. size: CSS background-size value.

_comment_animation: Tier 3. Canvas-based ambient animation. type: 'rain', 'snow', 'particles', 'static', or 'none'. intensity: 0.1–2.0 (scales particle/drop count). color: hex color for the animated elements.
